resources.string: Lets Ustaad carry out a task you started, with a Stop button on screen while it works.

Ustaad Hands carries out a task that you start in Ustaad, for example open a shopping app, find an item and add it to the cart.

What it reads: while a task runs it reads the screen of the app in front, the text, labels and buttons on it. It never reads what is typed into a password field.

What it does: it taps, scrolls and types for you, goes back or home, and opens apps and links.

When: only during a task that you started. A task that arrives from another app waits until you tap Run in Ustaad. While a task runs, a Stop button shows on top of the screen and in the notification.

What it never does: it never types a password, a code or a card number, and it never pays, orders or sends a message by itself. Anything like that needs your own tap in Ustaad.

What it reads stays on your own devices. Nothing is sent to a server.
